title: Your Loan Recovery: New Rules from RBI Mean More Respect, Less Harassment
description: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) has introduced new rules for how loan recovery agents can contact you. From July 1, 2026, agents can only call or visit betwee.

faq.q: What should I do if a recovery agent calls me outside the permitted hours?
faq.a: You should immediately report this violation to the grievance redressal officer of the bank or NBFC concerned. You can also escalate the matter to the RBI Ombudsman if your complaint is not resolved.

faq.q: Do these rules apply to credit card outstanding amounts too?
faq.a: Yes, these guidelines apply to all types of loans and credit facilities offered by regulated entities, including credit card outstanding amounts.

faq.q: Can a recovery agent visit my workplace?
faq.a: While agents can visit your premises, including your workplace, they must adhere to the prescribed timings (8:00 AM to 7:00 PM) and maintain respectful conduct without causing harassment or embarrassment.

faq.q: What kind of behaviour is considered "harassment" under these rules?
faq.a: Harassment includes using abusive language, making threats, intimidating you or your family, spreading false information, or repeatedly contacting you in a way that is designed to annoy or coerce.
Yes, these are official guidelines issued by the Reserve Bank of India, effective from July 1, 2026, and are part of the permanent regulatory framework for loan recovery.
